stem: Which line from the play indicates why the tour is significant for Sophia?

options.label: A
options.text: SOPHIA: I’m so excited! I’ve been fascinated by whales since, like, fourth grade, but I’ve never seen one in real life. (line 2)

options.label: B
options.text: SOPHIA: [With the serious tone of an expert.] Not likely to see an orca around here. This is humpback-whale territory. (line 5)

options.label: C
options.text: SOPHIA: Not to worry. [Stands up and points to herself.] You have your own tour guide standing right next to you. (line 9)

options.label: D
options.text: SOPHIA: [Watching the water hopefully.] He must be talking about Tornado. I’ve read all about her. (line 23)
